notes: Bindings per role (A-6, K-21). Runtime, model and effort were confirmed in the P0b spike on 14 October 2026 for codex and pi; the claude researcher binding was verified by the AC-10 run on 14 October 2026. Change a binding here and in launch-recipes.md together; the role prompt and result contract do not change.

researcher.checkout: existing integration or task checkout, no writing ownership (W-3)

implementer.checkout: own task worktree from the accepted base (W-1, W-2)

advisor.checkout: the paused implementer's task worktree, dirty state labelled (W-3)

reviewer.checkout: clean detached checkout at the candidate SHA (W-3, K-9)

debugger.checkout: clean detached checkout at the candidate SHA, or the paused task worktree when the failure only reproduces there

permission_recipes.pi-terminal-attach: <user's tested Pi command, verbatim>; attach with worker-start --terminal
permission_recipes.claude-read-only: claude --model <model> --effort <effort> --permission-mode dontAsk --allowedTools "Read,Grep,Glob,Bash(orca status:*),Bash(orca orchestration send:*),Bash(orca orchestration ask:*),Bash(orca orchestration check:*),mcp__context7__*" --disallowedTools "Edit,Write,NotebookEdit,Bash(git:*),Bash(orca terminal:*),Bash(orca worktree:*),Bash(orca orchestration worker-start:*),Bash(orca orchestration dispatch:*),Bash(orca orchestration run-create:*),Bash(orca orchestration task-create:*)"
